name: Gamma Strategies Clearing single-sided deposit ratio-check bypass
summary: Gamma's Clearing v1.2.3 gate, which UniProxy consults before every Hypervisor deposit, contains an exception in getDepositAmount: when IHypervisor(pos).totalSupply() == 0 || total0 == 0 || total1 == 0 it returns amountStart = 0 and amountEnd = depositNMax instead of the depositDelta/deltaScale ratio band. A Uniswap V3 vault whose liquidity range sits entirely on one side of the current price reports exactly that single-sided state, so clearDeposit's 'Improper ratio' requirement degenerates to a no-op. The attacker flash-borrowed DAI, swapped the gDAI/DAI pool from tick 1033 to tick 2257, deposited 270,000 gDAI plus 1 wei DAI into the gDAI-DAI Hypervisor 0x33985ca762541e2412f454c6f2e7ec677645d1df while getTotalAmounts() read (0, 3,299,168 DAI), and Hypervisor.deposit priced those shares off the manipulated pool.slot0() price. Withdrawing after the price was swapped back returned more value than was deposited. Gamma's own post-mortem states the same: the permissive per-vault price-change threshold was 'part of the issue', but 'the deeper root cause was due to an exception in the ratio checker function that allowed a deposit in any ratio so long as the vaults were single-sided'.
notes: Clearing v1.2.3 is a plain non-upgradeable contract deployed directly by EOA 0x71e7d05be74ff748c45402c06a941c822d756dc5 in transaction 0x74d2b510da30234c143381b8b245c4ce8e57583d7e52492369440f67cd35b2b6 at Arbitrum block 106809192. Its runtime code hash is 0x519823c3f9e3ec957571e4db9a367824c0a810284492374792fca48922f24d28 at the deployment block and unchanged at blocks 120000000, 140000000, 160000000 and 166874976 (exploit block minus one); the account is empty (0xc5d2460186f7233c927e7db2dcc703c0e500b653ca82273b7bfad8045d85a470) at block 106809191. The EIP-1967 implementation slot 0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc reads zero at block 166874976 and the contract exposes no upgrade entry point, so the deployment is the only executable-code change. Owner-settable values such as priceThreshold, twapInterval and the per-position overrides are configuration, not code, and are deliberately not used as the age basis.

Measured onchain as the net token gain of the attacker EOA 0x5351536145610aa448a8bf85ba97c71caf31909c and its exploit contract 0x4b57adc00ac38f74506d29fc4080e3dc65b78a69 across the seven successful transactions that exercised the defect against the gDAI-DAI Hypervisor 0x33985ca762541e2412f454c6f2e7ec677645d1df through Clearing 0xb8fb4031dc09b6d999722d2c51def7c0cebf41e2 (this anchor plus the six transactions in source-3), summing ERC-20 Transfer logs and excluding the vault's own LP token: +2,664,366.541704596120037455 gDAI and +23,529.583499026183550967 DAI. The vault's getTotalAmounts() falls from 845,148.50 gDAI / 2,351,580.97 DAI at block 166873000 to 70,248.87 gDAI / 1 wei DAI at block 166890500, consistent with this figure once the attacker's DAI-to-gDAI swaps through the pool are netted. Scope: this is the leg of the 4 January 2024 Gamma campaign gated by Clearing 0xb8fb4031, the reviewed code artifact. The same Clearing v1.2.3 defect exists in a second Arbitrum deployment 0x1f7792ed527a399159583730017cdb5003d57f4f (runtime hash 0xe0b3726ece505e92124109df6ea492e2b5dae631d406b51bab080dab825994e5), which gated the Camelot/Algebra vaults 0x61a7b3dae70d943c6f2ea9ba4ffd2fecc6af15e4 and 0x3d53ac3abec01827caae5bc934d46b171cea2206. A third Ramses-specific Clearing 0xcfb851b1b1345fe6c643e71f98b36ad887fa7db6 (runtime hash 0x89bfcde972bb307625f1260a630bdcc77fdec5232b798632efd3d98e22a250a1) gated the USDC-USDC.e vault 0x80709a760ff54112bd3e0ce31c104d912ba51774. Those legs are excluded here because they execute independently aged code artifacts and have their own non-overlapping loss records. Published campaign-wide figures are larger and disagree: Verichains reports about 6.2 million USD across four vaults with about 2.7 million USD for the gDAI-DAI vault (their gDAI figure of 2,388,217 omits the last of the seven transactions, 0x4024d440), and Rekt reports at least 4.5 million USD. No recovery is netted out. DefiLlama's nearest observations are 1704339694 for gDAI and 1704339333 for DAI.

The Camelot/Algebra legs execute Clearing 0x1f7792ed527a399159583730017cdb5003d57f4f, while the Ramses leg executes a third Clearing 0xcfb851b1b1345fe6c643e71f98b36ad887fa7db6. Both contain the same v1.2.3 exception but are independently aged runtime artifacts with separate non-overlapping loss records.
